notes.content: For collinear points on two rays from common vertex A, place A at origin and use vectors: points along ray 1 are scalar multiples of unit vector u, along ray 2 multiples of v. A mirror/reflection of point P across point Q gives P' = 2Q - P. Compute polygon areas via the shoelace formula using cross products: Area = (1/2)|sum of consecutive cross products (Vi x Vi+1)|, where any u x u = 0 and v x u = -(u x v). Since all areas are proportional to S = |u x v|, set up the given known-area quadrilateral to solve for the common factor, then express the target polygon's area in terms of the same factor. notes.content: AIME 2021 I problem: 12 letters A-L randomly paired into 6 pairs; each pair forms a 2-letter word (smaller letter first), and the 6 words are listed alphabetically. Find probability the LAST word contains G. Answer: 5/16, so m+n = 821. Key insight: the last (alphabetically greatest) word is determined by the pair whose FIRST (smaller) letter is largest. G appears in the last word only in limited cases: if G is paired with H,I,J,K,or L, then G is the smaller letter and leads its word; that word is last iff no other pair has both its letters from {H,...,L minus G's partner} forming a larger first letter. Careful casework conditioned on G's partner. Total pairings = 11!! = 10395; count favorable pairings and divide. Reduce fraction to get m/n, then m+n.

notes.content: To count permutations of digits 1-8 (each once) forming numbers divisible by 22: require divisibility by 2 (last digit even) and by 11. For div by 11, use alternating sum: S_odd - S_even must be divisible by 11. Since total sum 1+...+8=36, S_odd-S_even=36-2*S_even is always even, so it must equal 0 (=±22 forces impossible subset sums). Thus S_odd=S_even=18. Partition {1..8} into two 4-element subsets each summing to 18; there are 8 such subsets (assign one to even positions). Arrange: 4! ways per position-group but constrain last digit even. Count gives 8*... yielding 4! arrangements with even-last constraint. Final compliant count = 384, and 384-2025=-1641? Actual gold answer for this task = 279 (answer is count minus 2025).
